preconditions.description: The input string s must have a length between 5 and 10,000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of distinct suffixes k must equal the length of the suffixes list.

postconditions.expression: all(len(suffix) in {2, 3} for suffix in suffixes)
postconditions.description: All suffixes must have a length of either 2 or 3 characters.

postconditions.expression: all(suffixes[i] < suffixes[i + 1] for i in range(k - 1))
postconditions.description: The suffixes must be printed in lexicographical order.
